_comment: Pinned sources for the engine. vendor=true repos are small skill repos cloned into repos/vendor/ by scripts/setup_repos.sh at the exact commit tested. Libraries are installed with their package manager, never copied. license_gate=true means: do not clone, copy or use on client work until the user confirms a license (see license_notes/LICENSES.md). Package versions are pinned to releases at least 14 days old when this lock was written (2026-11-10).

repos.name: heygen-com/hyperframes
repos.install: npm i -D hyperframes@0.8.209  (or: npx hyperframes init <dir>) ; npx hyperframes skills update

repos.name: FFmpeg/FFmpeg
repos.install: macOS: brew install ffmpeg | Ubuntu: sudo apt install ffmpeg | Windows: winget install ffmpeg
repos.note: Use the OS package; do not vendor the source.

repos.name: Surya17155/yt-dlp
repos.install: python3 -m pip install -U "git+https://github.com/Surya17155/yt-dlp.git"   # fallback: python3 -m pip install -U yt-dlp
repos.note: User's fork. Sites change often; if extraction fails, install upstream yt-dlp/yt-dlp.

repos.name: bradautomates/claude-video
repos.install: claude plugin marketplace add bradautomates/claude-video && claude plugin install watch@claude-video
repos.note: Claude Code only (not Chat or Cowork).

repos.name: Pr1m4lc0d3/metaphrasis
repos.install: purchase a license, then follow the seller's instructions
repos.license: Proprietary (all rights reserved; sold per license)
repos.note: Not cloned, not copied into the zip, default OFF. Free equivalent path: audio-analyzer-rs + claude-sound-ear + scripts/analyze_audio.py.

repos.name: thetoyosibello/claude-sound-ear
repos.note: The project README shows the clone URL tysitv/claude-sound-ear (same project).

repos.name: JuzzyDee/audio-analyzer-rs
repos.install: cargo build --release && claude mcp add --scope user audio-analyzer -- $(pwd)/target/release/mcp-server   (or download the release binary / .mcpb)
repos.note: Local stdio MCP server: needs Claude Code or Claude Desktop.

repos.name: whaleyxbt/claude-motion
repos.install: cd repos/vendor/claude-motion && npm install && npm run build
repos.note: Skills: motion-design, review-loop, sound-design, web-sims. Needs Node 20+, Python 3, ffmpeg.

repos.name: remotion-dev/remotion
repos.install: npm i remotion@4.0.539 @remotion/cli@4.0.539 @remotion/three@4.0.539   (all @remotion/* packages must share one exact version)
repos.license: Remotion License (free for individuals and small companies; paid company license above that)

repos.name: greensock/GSAP
repos.note: Free for these uses; not for building a visual animation-builder product.

repos.name: JuneYaooo/rea-video
repos.note: Python 3.10+, ffmpeg. First run downloads a ~67 MB model. Optional vision model via REA_VLM_* environment variables.

repos.name: charlie947/motion-graphics-skills
repos.note: 15 skills incl. brand-intake, launch-video, reference-to-motion, motion-prompt-writer.

repos.name: EveryInc/product-launch-video
repos.note: Skill lives at .claude/skills/product-launch-video/SKILL.md; the Remotion scaffold needs the Remotion license check.

repos.name: latent-spaces/brag
repos.note: Large repo (113 MB) mostly media; only the skills/ folder is needed.

repos.name: feitangyuan/onetake
repos.install: git clone <url> (noncommercial use) or buy onetake Pro for commercial use
repos.note: Default OFF for client or business work. Not cloned by setup_repos.sh unless ALLOW_GATED=1.

added_by_director.name: yt-dlp/yt-dlp
added_by_director.reason: Upstream fallback when the fork lags behind site changes.

added_by_director.name: hexgrad/kokoro
added_by_director.license: Apache-2.0 (code); confirm model and voice terms before client use
added_by_director.reason: Free neutral text-to-speech when no ElevenLabs plan is available.

added_by_director.name: librosa
added_by_director.reason: Optional fallback for beat and onset tracking.

added_by_director.name: Blender
added_by_director.reason: Level 3 photoreal and silhouette product renders, run headless.

added_by_director.name: Playwright Chromium
added_by_director.reason: Headless browser for claude-motion web-sims and deterministic captures.
